title: Artificial-Intelligence-Applications-for-Healthcare
summary: A research codebase applying AI methods, including feature selection and oversampling, to the MMASH human activity/health monitoring dataset. It uses SDV's CopulaGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer to generate synthetic minority-class samples for oversampling, with SDV's SingleTableMetadata and evaluate_quality used to define schemas and assess the resulting synthetic data quality.
evidence: oversampling.py:616-627 fits/loads TVAESynthesizer via SingleTableMetadata and samples synthetic rows for oversampling
